title: Fruit Slash
shortDescription: Swipe to slice flying fruit, chain combos, and never hit a bomb.
description: Watermelons, oranges, apples, lemons, kiwis and plums come flying up from below. Swipe across them to slice them in half, cut three or more in one swipe for a combo bonus, and stay away from the bombs. The game plays in stages of bunches, lines and crossfire, each ending in a fruit frenzy or a bomb-filled fruit storm, and each stage is faster than the last.
howToPlay: Swipe across flying fruit to slice it.
Slice three or more fruit in one swipe for a combo bonus.
Never cut a bomb: it ends the game on the spot.
Every fruit that falls uncut costs one of your three lives.
Each stage ends in a finale: a fruit frenzy with no bombs, or a fruit storm with bombs among the fruit. Dropped fruit costs no life during a finale.

keys: Mouse: hold the button and swipe
